offers_products.reason: Mainly outsourced government program services and IT work; software and cloud platforms are secondary to service delivery.

offers_services.reason: Runs government health and human services programs, contact centers, veteran exams, and IT modernization and cloud operations.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are federal, state and local government agencies; citizens are served but the agencies buy.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Contracts with federal and state agencies in all 50 states, plus defense and homeland security.

recurring_revenue.reason: Multi-year government program operation contracts, such as contact centers and benefits administration, with renewals.

cyclical_demand.reason: Government-mandated health and human services programs, such as SNAP and Medicaid support, continue or grow in recessions.

big_ticket.reason: Revenue comes from ongoing program operations and service contracts, not single large purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Agencies pay mainly for Maximus staff running contact centers, case processing and clinical exams; technology supports this.

large_customers.reason: Customers are federal and state government agencies, including the Army, DoD and Homeland Security.

asset_heavy.reason: Delivers through staff, leased offices, contact centers and cloud partners; no plants or fleets.
